decision_anchors.label: PRELIMINARY
decision_anchors.note: Five decision-critical quantities re-derived from the same strict-cohort in-memory structures (df447/per/S/stepsS). Aggregates only; no cohort computation or existing value was changed.

_definitions.ceiling_exact_token: distinct 27447 patients with >=1 exact-token RT (single_rt) AND >=1 exact-token LT (single_lt) record, any interval
_definitions.ceiling_parse_modifier: distinct 27447 patients with >=1 parse_modifier single-side R AND >=1 single-side L record (includes multi_single_side e.g. 'RT XP'), any interval
_definitions.pregate_contra_5y_events_strict_age40: STRICT age>=40 index patients (S5=4203) with a contralateral laterality-coded 27447 in (90,1826] days from index, BEFORE the S6-S10 gates
_definitions.same_day_companion_strict: STRICT index patients (S4=4222) whose earliest 27447 date has exactly one parse_modifier single-side (RT xor LT) record PLUS >=1 same-day blank/NULL-modifier 27447 companion line (module-native single-side definition; definitive)
_definitions.same_day_companion_strict_exact_token: as same_day_companion_strict but counting only exact-token single_rt/single_lt as the single-side record; the 2604-vs-2597 gap is multi_single_side ('RT XP'-type) earliest lines (resolves the 2604-vs-2597 memo discrepancy)
_definitions.any_preindex_radiograph_1yr_n: STRICT age>=40 index patients (S5=4203) with ANY image (any laterality/view) with StudyDate in [index-365, index-1]
_definitions.contralateral_eligible_1yr_pct: S8/S5 = 1807/4203: contralateral-specific eligible pre-index image rate (contra laterality OR B-frontal, 1-365d), for contrast with the any-radiograph rate
_definitions.imaging_window_sensitivity_lever1: STRICT age>=40 (S5=4203) with >=1 eligible contralateral pre-index image (contra laterality OR B-frontal) per widening pre-index window; pct_increase_over_365 vs the 1-365d count; also written to stage1_imaging_window_sensitivity.csv
